personality_one_liner: A high-energy, performance-driven dark UI that feels athletic, reactive, and built for speed.

spacing.rule: Dense but scannable hierarchy. Limit padding on data-heavy elements but ensure touch targets are robust. Maintain 16pt page gutters.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary or surfaceTertiary for elevation.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism on this personality. Use color shifts and dividers.

screens.name: DiscoveryFeed
screens.purpose: Find local running groups with horizontal fast-filters (City, Pace, Day).

states.loading: Skeleton cards with pulsating surfaceTertiary elements.
states.empty: Illustration of a track and 'No groups match your filters' with a 'Clear Filters' button.
states.error: Error icon, 'Unable to load groups', Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with horizontal scrollable filter chips (City, Pace, Category) sitting above a vertical list of group cards. Group cards feature a cover image, gradient scrim, strong Barlow Condensed title, and next session metadata stacked compactly.

screens.name: GroupDetails
screens.purpose: View group info, check membership status, and see upcoming sessions.

states.error: Failed to load group details error message.

screens.layout: Hero image banner with top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Large title overlaid. Underneath, a sticky membership action button (Request/Join). Below: segmented stats (Members, Pace, Type) and a vertical list of 'Upcoming Sessions' cards.

screens.name: WorkoutCoordinator
screens.purpose: Map-based view of the workout location, route info, and RSVP status.

states.error: Map load failure or session deleted.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map background displaying the meeting pin. Bottom sheet (surfaceSecondary) containing the session title, date/time, distance (km), pace, and a sticky state-aware RSVP button (Going/Not Going/Full). A horizontal avatar stack shows participating runners.

screens.name: WeeklyCalendar
screens.purpose: A 7-day strip calendar showing the user's committed runs and activities.

states.empty: No runs scheduled this week. 'Find a group' CTA.

screens.layout: Top section features a horizontally scrollable 7-day date strip. Selecting a date updates the vertical list below, displaying detailed session cards for that day. High-contrast selected date styling (brand primary background).

screens.name: UserProfile
screens.purpose: Manage identity, bio, target pace, and view joined communities.

states.empty: N/A - User data is always present.

screens.layout: Avatar and user stats at the top. Form fields (read-only or editable) for Target Pace and Location. Below, a 'My Groups' horizontal shelf showing mini-cards of joined communities.

group_cover_urban.alt: Urban running group on track at night

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility personality (7) principles: use deep carbon grey/obsidian backgrounds (#101115) instead of pure black, with a high-energy Signal Red/Orange (#FF4D00) primary brand accent.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects for this personality. Use solid tonal layers (surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary) and dividers to establish hierarchy.
Use Barlow Condensed for all display headings, oversized metrics, and key data points. Use IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Ensure all primary CTAs are sticky above the home indicator, especially the state-aware RSVP button on the WorkoutCoordinator and the Membership button on GroupDetails.
Always apply a vertical top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse >= 70%) on image covers when text is overlaid.
For the Map UI on WorkoutCoordinator, use the provided map_bg image. Layer a bottom sheet (using @gorhom/bottom-sheet or a static view with pan gestures) over it for the session details.

Web Search Insights: Discovery feeds must utilize clear, horizontally scrollable filter chips (City, Pace, Vibe). RSVP buttons must be state-aware (Booked, Full, Open) and include social proof like 'Spots left' or 'Attendees'. Ensure the weekly calendar uses a 7-day horizontal strip pattern for quick navigation.
